entries.label: For this role, candidates must be in Omaha, NE for Summer 2026. Are you able to meet this requirement? (Please note- housing is not provided)
Why do you want to intern at Workshop?
entries.value: I build software for problems where the interesting part is whether people actually use the thing. With ClarityAtlas, the iOS health product I lead technically, the hard work was not just the passive sleep-estimation system I built on HealthKit and Core Motion signals like step count and gait speed. It was recruiting users, running a live Hopkins pilot with 30+ people, and repeatedly explaining why the product should exist. Internal communications software has the same shape: the measure of success is whether a message reaches an employee and does something, not whether the pipeline technically ran. Workshop being a venture-backed startup is a large part of the appeal. On the anomaly-detection system I work on at SAC Nexus, I own the repository and CI scaffold, the event-ingestion pipeline, and a versioned FastAPI service, and I have learned a lot from owning something end to end rather than picking up isolated tickets. I want an internship where a junior engineer is expected to ship real pieces of a product and hear from the people using them, and a team of Workshop's size and stage seems like where that actually happens.
